[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
import Lean.Data.String.Basic
import Lean.Data.String.Encodings

def implementation (s: String) : String :=
let words := s.split (fun c => c == ' ');
let ordered_words := words.map (fun w => w.map (fun c => c.val.toNat).sorted.map (fun n => n.toChar).toString);
ordered_words.join " "
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma split_join_eq
(s: String)
: s.split (fun c => c == ' ').join " " = s :=
by
  simp [String.split, String.join]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation s
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]
let words := s.split (fun c => c == ' ');
let ordered_words := words.map (fun w => w.map (fun c => c.val.toNat).sorted.map (fun n => n.toChar).toString);
have h_words := split_join_eq s
simp [h_words]
have h_words_length := List.length_eq_of_split_join words
simp [h_words_length]
have h_ordered_words := ordered_words.map (fun w => w.split (fun c => c == ' ').join " ").map (fun w' => w' = w).forall_true
simp [h_ordered_words]
have h_ordered_words_length := List.length_eq_of_split_join ordered_words
simp [h_ordered_words_length]
have h_words_eq_ordered_words := List.zip_eq_of_split_join words ordered_words
simp [h_words_eq_ordered_words]
have h_words_map_eq_ordered_words_map := List.zip_map_eq_of_split_join words ordered_words
simp [h_words_map_eq_ordered_words_map]
have h_words_map_data_eq_ordered_words_map_data := List.zip_map_data_eq_of_split_join words ordered_words
simp [h_words_map_data_eq_ordered_words_map_data]
have h_words_map_data_count_eq_ordered_words_map_data_count := List.zip_map_data_count_eq_of_split_join words ordered_words
simp [h_words_map_data_count_eq_ordered_words_map_data_count]
have h_words_map_data_sorted := List.zip_map_data_sorted_of_split_join words ordered_words
simp [h_words_map_data_sorted]
[END]
